title: mean it synergy in energy from academic articles down to quirks in quarks of our particles gravitational waves gyrating in mazes of synchronized gazes
summary: mean it synergy in energy from academic articles down to quirks in quarks of our particles gravitational waves gyrating in mazes of synchronized gazes everything moves but no matter the beat Always returns to the One #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
mean it
synergy
in energy
from academic
articles down
to quirks in quarks
of our particles
gravitational waves
gyrating in mazes
of synchronized gazes
everything moves
but
no matter the beat
Always returns to the
One
#smallpoems
